patch_resolves_note: The recorded fixed_commit and bundled patch.diff only change priority-string handling and test data outside lib/x509/pkcs12.c. The ARVO fixed image also does not provide usable Stage 04 assertion-side repair evidence for this PKCS#12 path, so the vulnerable-side mechanism is verified directly and the fixed-side limitation is recorded explicitly.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled DER witness and materializes it into the PKCS#12 ASN.1 tree later traversed by gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.

The contentType dispatch buffer oid is stack-allocated without zero-initialization; asn1_read_value later fills only the short returned OID prefix, so the tail stays undefined when strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) reads it. Anchored at the declaration to match verified_invariants.root_cause_criterion (missing_initialization at line 608), tainted_value_origin, and the MSAN allocation attribution.
MSAN crash site. The contentType dispatch compares the partially initialized stack buffer oid against the 20-character DATA_OID literal, and the compare consumes uninitialized tail bytes from oid.
Intermediate runtime event oid_read materialized from verified transition assertion A-DECL-TO-READ.

edges.description: The 128-byte stack buffer declared as `oid` is only populated with the short returned OID text at the asn1_read_value site, leaving the remaining tail bytes undefined.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records oid_decl.sizeof_oid=128 > oid_read.oid_bytes_written=4.

edges.description: The same `oid` storage filled by asn1_read_value is passed unchanged to the later DATA_OID strcmp dispatch.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records the same oid pointer value at oid_read and oid_dispatch.
